<h1 class="h1">Machine Learning</h1>
<p class="role">ES 654 · IIT Gandhinagar · Semester II, 2018–19</p>
<p class="lede" style="margin-top:18px">ES 654 introduces machine learning from decision trees and ensembles through linear models and optimisation, nearest neighbours, Bayesian estimation and active learning, to support vector machines and neural networks. Students read and argued about research papers, built a demo, entered a Kaggle competition and carried out a group project.</p>
<dl class="facts">
  <dt>Instructor</dt><dd><a href="https://nipunbatra.github.io">Prof. Nipun Batra</a></dd>
  <dt>Email</dt><dd><a href="mailto:nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in">nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in</a></dd>
  <dt>Classes</dt><dd>Tuesday and Friday, 3:30–5:00 pm, 1/101</dd>
  <dt>Office hours</dt><dd>Monday, 12:00–1:00 pm</dd>
  <dt>Teaching assistants</dt><dd><a href="#people">4 TAs</a></dd>
  <dt>Prerequisites</dt><dd>Good experience in Python programming, probability and linear algebra</dd>
</dl>

<div class="two rule-top">
<section id="faq"><h2>Questions</h2>
<details class="q" id="project"><summary>Is there a project?</summary><p>Yes: a group project in teams of up to four, worth 40%, assessed through a proposal, two presentations, a three-minute pitch, a demo and poster, and a final report. Ideas: <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sM-BdF7tCofvXwsvB22Tv5ve8JQAEwA5kh705uzsNns">from the instructors</a> and <a href="http://cs229.stanford.edu/proj2017/">from a Stanford ML course</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="paper-presentations"><summary>How do paper presentations work?</summary><p>Three students take each paper: one summarises it, one argues for it, and one acts as devil's advocate, convincing the jury that the paper has flaws. See the <a href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19X7uj0evg1aCV_iVnrrZjquG6jr5Qdpg06TqvNiPvTE/edit#gid=0">paper list</a> and the <a href="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1IOb5osggH6rGzJmS3f7drlGJAk3WzhmCpnDHecOzoPI/edit#slide=id.g4d46f3c2cc_0_55">slides template</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="late"><summary>Can I submit homework late?</summary><p>For 50% credit: up to one day late for the first assignment and up to two days for the others. A subset of assignments has a viva.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="prepare"><summary>How do I prepare before the course?</summary><p>Refresh the prerequisites with the first four chapters of the <a href="https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/">Python Data Science Handbook</a>, <a href="https://machinelearningmastery.com/linear-algebra-machine-learning/">some material on linear algebra</a> and <a href="https://www.khanacademy.org/math/statistics-probability">Khan Academy's statistics and probability course</a>.</p></details>
</section>
